Definition: Jogbehah, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Jogbehah is named twice in the Bible, and the passages here are Numbers 32:35; Judges 8:11. In Numbers 32:35, the record says, "And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,". It is named again in Judges 8:11: "And Gideon went up by the way of them that dwelt in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and smote the host..."
TheologicalSignificance: Jogbehah is a place God put on the map of his story, and I believe that matters.
